facts.business: S.A.L. Steel Limited manufactures and sells Sponge Iron and Ferro Alloys directly to end-use customers.
key_risks: Revenue recognition risk - risk that revenue is recognized before control of goods is transferred
Litigations and claims pending with multiple tax authorities (Service tax, VAT, Income Tax, Excise, GST & customs) and customer claims not acknowledged as debt
facts.related_party_note: Unsecured Inter Corporate Deposit of Rs 16,560.13 lakhs payable to related party (Note No. 37). Secured borrowings include personal guarantees of Mr. Mahesh Kumar Agarwal and Corporate Guarantee of M/s. Sree Metaliks Limited.
